title: 开始阅读最后更新：2026-07-23 03:45:14 最新章节：第1000章 黄山剑宗弟子
slug: 开局战五渣我靠空间挂机修仙
content_zh:
“大哥，这小子不会死了吧？要是死了，黄山剑宗肯定不会放过我们的。”
“别胡说，他死不死的和我们有什么关系，死了也是矿洞塌了砸死的！”一个粗犷男子狠狠瞪了小弟一眼，厉声喝道。
秦怀安迷迷糊糊醒过来时，正好听到了这两人的对话。
这时，一幕幕不属于他的记忆画面冲入脑海，秦怀安感觉头疼欲裂，下意识的揉捏着太阳穴。
“他还活着！”
“算这小子命大，我们走！”粗犷男子色厉内荏的瞪了秦怀安一眼说道。并熟练的把他矿篓中的矿石倒进自己矿篓，带着小弟们匆忙离去。
......
良久之后，秦怀安目光渐渐变清明了。他穿越了，从996社畜变成了挖矿的矿工。
这里是黄山剑宗的一处矿脉，他们都是被雇佣来挖矿的。
黄山剑宗是方圆数十万里最大的修仙门派，那几个矿霸也不敢在这里搞出了人命，否则难逃责罚。
原主也叫秦怀安，本是在启国南部边境的云田坊市求生的一名散修。靠着偶尔进山采药，或者帮坊市里的店铺做些药材初步处理的零工获得一些修炼资源。
云田坊市是黄山剑宗在启国设置的一个坊市，也是启国唯一的修仙者聚集地。坊市再往南就是无边的百万大山。
最近黄山剑宗的赤铜矿脉在坊市招募矿工，待遇丰厚，秦怀安就报名来到此矿脉。没想到刚来两天就遇到矿霸了。
矿洞里面蜿蜒曲折，岔路极多。这些人专门找落单的修士，抢劫他们挖到的矿石。只要不出人命，不把事情闹大，矿脉管理人员一般也懒得管。
原主性格刚烈，拒不交出挖出来的矿石。被粗犷男子一拳击飞，头碰到矿洞壁上一命呜呼。秦怀安这才占据了原主的身体。
“上班路上跳到太平河，去救落水的小女孩，竟把自己搭进去了。太平河也不太平啊，估计会被发一个见义勇为的勋章吧。”秦怀安暗暗苦笑。
“咕噜噜...”这时肚子传来低沉的抗议声，秦怀安这才意识到，他已经一天没有吃东西了。他从怀中摸出一粒辟谷丹塞到嘴里，嗯...不错，还是草莓味的。
这些矿霸竟然没搜身就着急走了，这么善良的吗？莫非是怕自己和他们拼命，死在他们面前？还是看着自己太穷酸没什么东西？秦怀安讪讪一笑，没再多想。
然后他又从怀中摸索出几样东西，3块下品灵石，两粒辟谷丹，一粒回气丹，一张神行符，一张金刚符，一本记载青华诀的小册子，这是秦怀安身上所有家当了。原主在云田坊市租有一间洞府，还有两个月到期，再赚不到灵石就要流落荒野了。
“一粒辟谷丹的作用只有一天，得挖矿赚灵石了。这些该死的矿霸，上辈子都没有经历过的职场霸凌，这一穿越过来就被补上了。”秦怀安自嘲的背起矿篓，提着矿镐走向矿洞深处，得先活下去。

赤铜矿石坚硬无比，普通凡人是无法挖掘的，修士挖矿也需要用特制的矿镐。
两天后，赤红色的矿石已经装了大半个矿篓。这两天运气好像变好了，挖的矿石比前几天加起来都多。这莫非是新手期福利？
矿石很重，好在现在秦怀安是修仙者，虽然修为一般，但比起凡人来，力气要大的多。他擦了擦额头的汗水，吃下最后一粒辟谷丹。
该回坊市休整一下了，一直挖矿也不是办法。
……
“一共813斤，算你8块灵石。”矿洞口黄山剑宗的矿脉管理人员面无表情的说道，随手把灵石递给秦怀安。
每开采100斤普通赤铜矿石可获得一块灵石；如果开采到赤铜精，一斤赤铜精就可以获得一块灵石。
“多谢前辈。”
秦怀安接过灵石，朝管理人员道谢后，正要往外走，这时传来到一道熟悉的声音。
“大哥，这两天收获不错，他们挖到的矿石都比平时要多。照这样下去，我们再干几天，攒一笔钱，回去了到风月阁好好享受享受，梦蝶仙子那曲儿唱的，啧啧...”
content_en:
"Brother, is this kid dead? If he dies, the Huangshan Sword Sect will definitely not let us go."
"Don't talk nonsense. Does it have anything to do with us whether he is dead or not? Even if he is dead, he was killed by the collapse of the mine!" A rough man glared at his younger brother and shouted sternly.
When Qin Huaian woke up in a daze, he happened to hear the conversation between the two people.
At this time, scenes of memories that did not belong to him rushed into his mind. Qin Huaian felt a splitting headache and subconsciously rubbed his temples.
"He's still alive!"
"This kid is lucky, let's go!" The rugged man glared at Qin Huaian and said. He skillfully poured the ore from his mining basket into his own mining basket and left in a hurry with his younger brothers.
...
After a long time, Qin Huaian's eyes gradually became clearer. He traveled through time and changed from a 996 social animal to a mining miner.
This is a mineral vein of the Huangshan Sword Sect, and they are all hired to mine.
The Huangshan Sword Sect is the largest immortal cultivating sect within hundreds of thousands of miles, and those few mining tyrants dare not kill anyone here, otherwise they will not be able to escape punishment.
The original owner, also named Qin Huaian, was a casual cultivator who was trying to survive in Yuntianfang City on the southern border of Qi State. He obtained some cultivation resources by occasionally going into the mountains to collect herbs, or doing odd jobs doing preliminary processing of medicinal materials for shops in the city.
Yuntianfang City is a city set up by the Huangshan Sword Sect in Qi State. It is also the only gathering place for immortal cultivators in Qi State. Further south from Fangshi is the boundless Million Mountains.
Recently, Huangshan Jianzong's red copper vein was recruiting miners in Fang City, and the remuneration was generous, so Qin Huaian signed up to come to this vein. Unexpectedly, I met a mining bully just two days after arriving.
The mine is winding and winding, with many side roads. These people specifically look for lone monks and rob them of the ore they have dug. As long as no one is killed and the matter is not made big, the mine managers generally don't bother to take care of it.
The original owner had a strong character and refused to hand over the excavated ore. He was punched away by the rough man, and his head hit the wall of the mine, dying. Only then did Qin Huaian take over the body of the original owner.
"I jumped into the Taiping River on the way to work to save a little girl who fell into the water, and actually got myself into it. The Taiping River is not very flat either. I guess I will be awarded a medal for bravery." Qin Huaian smiled secretly.
"Gululu..." At this time, a low protest came from his stomach, and Qin Huaian realized that he had not eaten for a day. He took out a Bigu Pill from his arms and stuffed it into his mouth. Hmm...yes, it was strawberry flavored.
These mining bullies left in a hurry without searching their bodies. Are they so kind? Could it be that he was afraid that he would fight them and die in front of them? Or do you think you are too poor and have nothing? Qin Huaian smiled and didn't think more about it.
Then he groped for a few more things from his arms, three low-grade spiritual stones, two Bigu Pills, one Qi Restoration Pill, a Divine Walking Talisman, a Diamond Talisman, and a booklet recording the Qinghua Jue. These were all Qin Huaian's belongings. The original owner rented a cave in Yuntianfang City, and there are still two months until the expiration date. If he can't earn spiritual stones, he will live in the wilderness.
"A Bigu Pill is only effective for one day, so you have to mine to earn spiritual stones. These damn mining tyrants have never experienced workplace bullying in their previous lives, and they have made up for it this time around." Qin Huaian mocked himself as he picked up the mining basket and walked deep into the mine with the mining pick. He had to survive first.
The red copper ore is extremely hard and cannot be mined by ordinary mortals. Monks also need special mining picks to mine.
Two days later, most of the ore basket was filled with red ore. My luck seems to have improved in the past two days, and I have mined more ore than the previous few days combined. Could this be a novice period benefit?
The ore is very heavy. Fortunately, Qin Huaian is an immortal cultivator now. Although his cultivation level is average, he is much stronger than a mortal. He wiped the sweat from his forehead and took the last Bigu Pill.
It's time to go back to the market to rest, and mining all the time is not an option.…
"A total of 813 kilograms, including 8 spirit stones for you." The mine manager of the Huangshan Sword Sect at the entrance of the mine said expressionlessly, and handed the spirit stones to Qin Huaian.
For every 100 kilograms of ordinary red copper ore mined, one spiritual stone can be obtained; if one kilogram of red copper essence is mined, one spiritual stone can be obtained for one kilogram of red copper fine.
"Thank you, senior."
Qin Huaian took the spirit stone, thanked the management staff, and was about to walk out when he heard a familiar voice.
"Brother, the harvest has been good these two days. They have dug more ore than usual. If we continue like this, we will work for a few more days, save some money, and go back to Fengyue Pavilion to enjoy it. The song sung by Fairy Mengdie, tsk tsk..."
